purpose: Phase 3 merge-pair shortlist (same-type block pairs for format-native merging)
selection_principles: same-type pairs only (all 93 scanned pairs are linear_attention; full-attn blocks are 4 apart so no full-full pair has gap<=3)
higher mean_cos of residual updates = more shared computation = better merge candidate; non-degenerate ceiling ~0.32
block 0 excluded (BI 0.90, embedding-adjacent); blocks 1, 2, 63 treated as suspicious
prefer members with measured low single-drop KL in both regimes; overlap with k8 set {16,12,13,9,8,4,5,15} enables matched merge-vs-drop comparisons
adjacent (gap 1) pairs cleanest for x+fA(x)+fB(x+fA(x)) ~ x+fM(x); gap pairs flagged
negative mean_cos pairs are anti-candidates (merging cancels computation)

excluded_pairs.reason: highest cos overall (+0.646) but contains block 0 (BI 0.90, untouchable)
contains block 0; also strongly negative (-0.641): block 2 largely cancels the 0-1 update

shortlist.rationale: Best all-round candidate. Adjacent (clean merge algebra), cos +0.153 (4th-best non-degenerate). Both members in the k8 drop set, both individually cheapest to remove (BI 0.0208/0.0248 = two lowest in the network; single KLs 0.0047/0.0038 on-policy, 0.038/0.042 off-policy). Enables direct matched comparison merge[4,5] vs drop[4], drop[5], drop[4,5].

Highest non-degenerate cos (+0.318) in the whole scan -> most shared computation. But gap-2 pair spanning full-attn block 19, and block 18 has BI 0.140 (3rd highest). Merge preserves (approximate) computation unlike drop, so worth one shot; treat as high-risk/high-signal probe.

Adjacent, cos +0.167. Block 17 measured cheap (KL 0.0049 on / 0.0166 off, BI 0.035). Block 18 is the risky member (BI 0.140); a merge that keeps its computation alive is the gentler way to touch it than dropping. Safer sibling of the 18-20 probe.

Adjacent, cos +0.182, benign BIs (0.048/0.051), comfortably away from untouchable 63. 60/61/62 form a correlated late-network cluster (60-62 cos +0.095, 61-62 +0.187); this is the safest entry into it. No single-drop KL measured yet.
Adjacent, cos +0.187 (best gap-1 value outside block-0 pair). Downranked vs 60-61 because 62 has BI 0.085 (top-10) and sits directly before high-BI block 63 (BI 0.226, untouchable).

Second-highest cos (+0.315) but heavily flagged: block 1 is on the suspicious list and has the highest measured off-policy single KL (0.113 vs 0.0076 on-policy), and the gap spans suspicious block 2 (BI 0.132) plus full-attn block 3. Early-network push-pull structure (1-2 cos -0.386) makes this region fragile. Keep on list only as a flagged long-shot.

Gap-3 pair, cos +0.124. Both members in k8, both measured cheap (KLs 0.0039/0.0035 on-policy, 0.042/0.031 off-policy; BIs 0.025/0.025). Strong matched-comparison value against the k8 drops, but the merge must commute past linear block 6 (BI 0.102) and full-attn block 7 - flag the gap hard.
Adjacent, cos +0.096. Block 13 in k8 and measured cheap (KL 0.0037 on / 0.0177 off, BI 0.026); block 14 unmeasured (BI 0.058). Modest cos, but clean algebra and half-matched to existing drop data.

anti_candidates.note: Block 2's update anti-correlates with block 1's (cos -0.386); merging would cancel computation. Worst non-block-0 pair; block 2 BI 0.132 (suspicious list).
cos -0.299; block 6 (BI 0.102) pushes opposite to block 8. Do not merge across this pair.

cos -0.269; confirms an alternating push-pull pattern in blocks 6-14 (gap-2 pairs there are all negative: 2-4 -0.257, 4-6 -0.226, 10-12 -0.147, 12-14 -0.130). Gap-2 merges in this region are contraindicated.

notes: Block 15 (k8 member) is full-attention; its nearest same-type neighbors are 4 apart, so it has no eligible merge pair.

Mid-network gap-1 cos values among k8 members are near-orthogonal (8-9 +0.038, 12-13 +0.027): individually cheap to drop but little shared computation, so a merge there buys little over a drop; left off the top 8.
Off-policy KL is uniformly ~4-15x on-policy KL for the same block; block 1 is the extreme outlier (0.0076 on vs 0.113 off).
